sources.snippet: The code, pre-trained model weights, and training logs are publicly released to promote open science in speech foundation models. Inference examples can be found on our project page. The Gradio demo is here. OWSM v4 is the latest version in the OWSM series, which significantly outperforms OWSM v3.1 in LID and multilingual ASR.
